messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty -> Escalation policy 'realtime-inference' fired: INC-2026 · P1. Primary oncall @Maya did not acknowledge; paging secondary in 60s.
PagerDuty: Alert INC-2026 fired for service 'hosted-inference' — symptom: error_rate > 5% (us-east-1). Targets: Maya, Jordan, Ken. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026
Maya: seeing the page.. trying to ack but PD UI is stuck on SSO redirect loop for me :facepalm:
Jordan: I got two pages 10s apart — looks like duplicate webhook delivery. I acked the second one (the first kept showing as "paged" but unackable).
Sam: digging in infra now. prelim: one of the PD webhooks retried rapidly -> duplicate alert ids; separate issue: node rwd-inf-12 in us-east showing 100% CPU and 503s from model-worker.
Maya: confirmed errors in app logs when I can open them — client requests timing out with 503.
Sam: posting quick logs:
```
[2026-03-15T21:07:11Z] rwd-inf-12 model-worker ERROR serving request id=abc123 status=503 backend="kv-cache" error="timeout after 120s"
[2026-03-15T21:07:13Z] rwd-inf-12 kernel INFO CGroup stealing spiking, cpu: 98%
```
Priya: customer impact: hosted inference tail latency jumped and ~3% of requests failed with 503 across a small subset of customers in us-east. No data loss. Customers seeing timeouts (~1.8-2.5s extra).
IncidentBot: Primary unacked for 8m -> Escalation to manager Ken fired. Manager page sent.
Ken: joining bridge now. Can someone drop the quick PD note with what we've seen? I'll try to stop the duplicate pages first.
Jordan: adding PD note: "duplicate webhooks -> duplicate alerts; node rwd-inf-12 CPU spike -> 503s; restart in progress". Acked the incident in PD just now.
Maya: FYI I couldn't access PD UI because my SSO cookie profile was wrong (switched to personal account). Fixed locally, acked. sorry for the delay.
Sam: mitigation actions: 1) restarted model-worker on rwd-inf-12 -> worker came back and error rate dropped. 2) reverted a kernel patch from last night that caused cpu scheduler thrash on that instance. 3) temporarily applied PD suppression rule to dedupe webhook id for 15m.
Ken: good. Please silence escalations for the reproduced duplicate webhook id so we don't keep waking more people.
Sam: suppression applied from CLI: `pd incidents silence --id INC-2026 --reason "webhook-duplication" --duration 15m`
Jordan: after restart, error rate back to normal in us-east. Monitoring for 15m.
Priya: working on customer comms. Draft: "We experienced a short interruption to hosted inference in us-east causing brief request failures for a subset of customers. Root cause: duplicate PagerDuty webhook retries combined with a node CPU regression; we rolled back the change and restarted affected workers. No customer data was exposed. Follow-up: runbook and webhook retry settings will be updated."
Ken: action items (capture):
- Sam -> postmortem + root cause analysis for kernel regression and node selection (owner).
- Maya -> update oncall runbook for PD ack steps during SSO issues + quick link to alternative ack method (owner).
- Eng-infra -> add webhook-id dedupe in PD ingestion (owner: Sam/infra).
- Priya -> send customer comms and coordinate with support.
Maya: I'll add the runbook items and link to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/pd-webhook-playbook
Sam: leaving monitoring on for 1h, will post to #postmortems in 2h with timeline and logs.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026 status: RESOLVED (auto-close). Downgraded to P2 for postmortem follow-up.
Ken: thanks everyone — good catch on the duplicate webhooks. We'll follow up with a short RFC to address webhook retries and improve PD ingestion dedupe. :thumbsup:
